title: Set 98

sentences.ko: 나 다시 앉게 두지 마. 케이크 나올 때까지 여기 있으면 나 진짜 못 빠져나가. 내일 아침 일곱 시에 동생 비행기가 도착하는데 데리러 가는 사람이 나야. 그러니까 그게 내 핑계고, 난 그거 쓸 거야. 우리 무슨 얘기 하는 중인 것처럼 보이게 문까지 같이 걸어가 줘.
sentences.text: Okay, don't let me sit back down, because if I'm still here when the cake comes out I'm never getting out of here. My brother's flight lands at seven tomorrow morning and I'm the one picking him up, so that's my excuse and I'm using it. Walk me to the door so it looks like we're in the middle of something.

alts.text: Okay, if I sit back down I'm done. If I'm still here for the cake, I'm never getting out of here. My brother lands at seven tomorrow morning and I'm the one getting him, so that's my excuse and I'm using it. Walk me out so it looks like we're in the middle of something.

Please do not let me sit back down, because if I am still here when the cake comes out I will never get out of here. My brother's flight lands at seven tomorrow morning and I am the one collecting him, so that is my excuse and I intend to use it. Would you walk me to the door so it appears we are in the middle of something?

sentences.note: **that's my excuse and I'm using it** 은 빠져나갈 구실이 생겼으니 그대로 써먹겠다는 뜻입니다. **walk me to the door** 는 문까지 바래다 달라는 말이고요.
sentences.situation: 저녁 모임에서 먼저 일어날 구실 만들기

sentences.ko: 열하루를 버텼고 그동안은 멀쩡했어. 그런데 수요일에 누가 회사 탕비실에 도넛 한 상자를 두고 갔더라고. 나를 무너뜨리는 건 저녁이 아니야. 저녁은 미리 계획을 세우니까. 문제는 네 시쯤이야. 배가 고픈 것도 아니고 그냥 심심한데 바로 옆에 있으니까 먹는 거지. 그리고 나 이 얘기 전에도 똑같이 한 거 알아.
sentences.text: I made it eleven days and I was fine the whole time, and then Wednesday somebody left a box of donuts in the kitchen at work. It's never dinner that gets me, because dinner I plan out. It's that four o'clock thing where I'm not even hungry, I'm just bored and I'm sitting right there. And I know I've told you this exact story before.

alts.text: Eleven days in and I was doing fine, and then Wednesday somebody left a box of donuts in the kitchen at work. Dinner's never the problem, cause dinner I plan out. It's that four o'clock thing where I'm not even hungry, I'm just bored and I'm sitting right there. And yeah, I know I've told you this exact story before.

I managed eleven days and I was fine the entire time, and then on Wednesday somebody left a box of donuts in the kitchen at work. It is never dinner that gets me, because dinner I plan out. It is that four o'clock stretch where I am not even hungry, I am simply bored and sitting right there. And I am aware that I have told you this exact story before.

sentences.note: **I made it eleven days** 는 십일 일을 버텨 냈다는 말입니다. **gets me** 는 나를 무너뜨린다, 나를 못 참게 만든다는 뜻으로 씁니다.

sentences.ko: 드디어 레인지를 바꿨는데 솔직히 예전 게 다시 갖고 싶어. 이건 화면이 달려 있어서 불을 줄이려면 메뉴를 눌러 들어가야 하는데 그러는 동안 팬은 벌써 연기가 나. 아내가 타이머 맞추는 법을 물었는데 나도 대답을 못 해서 이제는 그냥 전자레인지를 써. 고장 난 데는 하나도 없어. 그냥 돌리는 손잡이가 그리워.
sentences.text: I finally replaced the stove and honestly I want the old one back. This one's got a screen on it, so when I need to turn the heat down I'm tapping through menus while the pan's already smoking. My wife asked me how to set the timer and I couldn't tell her, so she just uses the microwave now. Nothing's wrong with it. I just miss the dial.

alts.text: So I finally got a new stove and honestly? I want the old one back. It's got a screen on it, so when I gotta turn the heat down I'm tapping through menus while the pan's already smoking. My wife asked me how to set the timer and I had no idea, so now she just uses the microwave. Nothing's wrong with it. I just miss the dial.

I finally replaced the stove, and honestly I would like the old one back. This one has a screen on it, so when I need to turn the heat down I am tapping through menus while the pan is already smoking. My wife asked me how to set the timer and I could not tell her, so she now simply uses the microwave. There is nothing wrong with it. I merely miss the dial.

sentences.note: **the dial** 은 돌려서 맞추는 손잡이를 말합니다. **Nothing's wrong with it** 은 물건 자체에는 아무 문제가 없다는 뜻입니다.

sentences.ko: 선생님이 책 읽기 때문에 또 메일을 보냈어. 그런데 나도 선생님 말이 틀렸다고 생각하지 않거든. 그게 제일 신경 쓰여. 애가 수업 시간에는 잘해. 집에서만 내가 바로 옆에 앉아 있지 않으면 손도 안 대고, 내가 설거지하러 일어나는 순간 그날은 끝이야. 너희 애도 그래? 아니면 우리 애만 그런 거야?
sentences.text: Her teacher emailed me about the reading again, and I don't even disagree with her, that's the part that bugs me. She's fine in class. She just won't touch it at home unless I'm sitting right next to her, and the second I get up to start the dishes she's done for the night. Is yours like that, or is it just mine?

alts.text: So the teacher emailed about the reading again, and the thing is she's not wrong, that's what bugs me. She's fine in class. She just won't touch it at home unless I'm right there next to her, and the second I get up to do the dishes she's done for the night. Is yours like that, or is it just mine?

Her teacher emailed me about the reading again, and I do not even disagree with her, which is the part that bothers me. She is fine in class. She simply will not touch it at home unless I am sitting right beside her, and the moment I get up to start the dishes she is finished for the night. Is yours like that, or is it only mine?

sentences.note: **bugs me** 는 신경을 긁는다, 마음에 걸린다는 뜻입니다. **won't touch it** 은 아예 손도 안 댄다는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 이사 온 뒤로 계속 하겠다고 말만 하던 차고 정리를 드디어 했어. 하루를 다 썼는데 버린 건 상자 네 개쯤이야. 집어 드는 것마다 남겨 둘 이유가 있더라고. 아내가 일 년 동안 손 안 댄 물건에는 스티커를 붙이라고 했는데, 나는 뭘 손댄 걸로 칠지를 아주 창의적으로 정했지. 그래서 안은 전이랑 똑같아 보여. 그래도 차는 이제 들어가.
sentences.text: We finally cleaned out the garage, which I've been saying we'd do since we moved in. It took the whole day and we got rid of maybe four boxes, because everything I picked up I had a reason to keep. My wife made me put a sticker on anything I hadn't touched in a year, and I got real creative about what counts as touching it. So it looks exactly the same in there, but the car fits now.

alts.text: So we finally did the garage, which I've been saying we'd do since we moved in. Took all day and we got rid of like four boxes, cause everything I picked up I had a reason to keep. My wife made me put a sticker on anything I hadn't touched in a year, and I got real creative about what counts as touching it. Looks exactly the same in there, but the car fits now.

We finally cleaned out the garage, which I have been saying we would do since we moved in. It took the entire day and we disposed of perhaps four boxes, because everything I picked up I had a reason to keep. My wife had me put a sticker on anything I had not touched in a year, and I became rather creative about what counts as touching it. It looks exactly the same in there, but the car fits now.

sentences.note: **cleaned out** 은 안에 있는 걸 다 꺼내서 정리했다는 뜻입니다. **got real creative about what counts as touching it** 은 규칙을 자기한테 유리하게 해석했다는 농담입니다.

reviewed: 1·3·4·5번의 casual 이 text 와 첫 문장이 거의 그대로 겹쳐서, 더 짧고 축약된 구어로 앞부분을 다시 썼습니다 (관용구를 새로 넣지 않고 말투만 낮췄습니다).
2번 한국어 '십일 일을 버텼고' 가 읽기 어색해서 '열하루를 버텼고' 로 고쳤습니다.
5번 한국어의 '손을 댔다는 게 뭔지에 대해서 아주 창의적이 됐지' 가 번역투라, 뭘 손댄 걸로 칠지를 창의적으로 정했다는 말로 고쳤습니다.
5번 formal 의 'My wife required me to put' 이 사람 말투가 아니어서 'had me put' 으로 고쳤습니다. 뜻은 그대로입니다.
3번 한국어 마지막 줄 '그리울 뿐이야' 를 '그리워' 로 줄여 말맛을 맞췄습니다.
note 의 별표 표현은 다섯 개 모두 text 안에 실제로 있어 손대지 않았고, 영어 text 도 그대로 두었습니다.
